claims.says: In every state reachable under any interleaving of the modelled MVCC protocol, every snapshot a reader or BGSAVE fork took is a version some commit published whole.
In every state reachable under any interleaving of the modelled MVCC protocol, the published graph version is exactly the acknowledged writes, in acknowledgement order.
Over any interleaving of CREATE INDEX on one label and populate batches, when no creation is between storing its entry and taking its ticket, an OPERATIONAL index has every field in every batch.
If every vector field's dimension is registered with RediSearch, every entry Document::set makes for every field of an entity ends up in the stored index document, whatever the values.
Whatever k a user passes, a vector KNN query that succeeds clamps k to at most max(count, 1) and keeps its buffers and result rows within the live entity count.
